name: Engineering-Numerical-Methods-Benchmark
description: A collection of problems and prompts testing numerical methods used in engineering (e.g., interpolation, numerical integration, solution of ODEs/PDEs). It measures models' ability to reason about, set up, and compute numerical-methods solutions, often requiring stepwise calculations or code-like pseudocode. Tasks typically expect numerical answers or short solution descriptions.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset for engineering numerical-methods problems with limited community adoption outside specialized educational use.
